name: button
title: Button
description: A button or a component that looks like a button.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { Spinner } from '$lib/components/ui/spinner';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';
  import { type ButtonSize, type ButtonVariant, buttonVariants } from './button-variants';

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    variant,
    size,
    children,
    loading,
    ...restProps
  }: Button.RootProps & {
    variant?: ButtonVariant;
    size?: ButtonSize;
    class?: string;
    children?: Snippet;
    loading?: boolean;
  } = $props();
</script>

<Button.Root
  bind:ref
  class={cn(buttonVariants({ size, variant }), className)}
  data-slot="button"
  {...restProps}
>
  {#if loading === true}
    <Spinner /> {@render children?.()}
  {:else}
    {@render children?.()}
  {/if}
</Button.Root>
